cases.source:
---
description:
  Exercises edges written with increasing numbers of dashes (---, ---->, ----->,
  ======>) plus dotted and labeled variants, verifying that the layout honors
  the user-specified minimum edge length implied by the dash count between
  ranks.
---
graph TD
  L1 --- L2
  L2 --- C
  M1 ---> C
  R1 .-> R2
  R2 <.-> C
  C -->|Label 1| E1
  C -- Label 2 ---> E2
  C ----> E3
  C -----> E4
  C ======> E5

---
description:
  Broad sampling of edge-line variants (plain, dotted, thick, arrowed,
  bidirectional, and labeled) combined with increasing dash counts, checking
  that edge rendering style and effective length both scale correctly with the
  syntax used.
---
flowchart TD
  L1 --- L2
  L2 --- C
  M1 ---> C
  R1 .-> R2
  R2 <.-> C
  C -->|Label 1| E1
  C <-- Label 2 ---> E2
  C ----> E3
  C <-...-> E4
  C ======> E5

cases.source:
---
description:
  Verifies that open edges drawn with the plain-line syntax (---), whether
  unlabeled, given an inline label, or given a `-- text --` label, render
  without arrowheads, in contrast to a bidirectional edge (<-- ... -->) which
  does show arrowheads on both ends.
---
flowchart TD
  A -- label text --- B
  C --- D
  E -- open label --- F
  G <-- bidirectional --> H
